sloka: तमेव दिवसं सो ऽथ हैहयाधिपतिर्बली ।अर्जुनो नर्मदां रन्तुं गतः स्त्रीभिः सहेश्वरः ।। ७.३१.९ ॥
transliteration: tameva divasaṁ so 'tha haihayādhipatirbalī ।arjuno narmadāṁ rantuṁ gataḥ strībhiḥ saheśvaraḥ ।। 7.31.9 ॥

translations.english: On that very day, the powerful lord of the Haihayas, Arjuna, had gone to the Narmada river with his wives to sport.
